Artist Unknown
Agate and Geode Specimen Set
Polished Agate and Natural Crystal Geode
Total Weight: 3.0 lbs
Unsigned
This set of two geological specimens features a large, polished teal-blue agate slice and a natural crystal geode. The blue specimen is expertly cut with a flat base and polished faces, showcasing deep color saturation and a natural crystalline window. The companion piece is a classic geode with a detailed crystalline cavity surrounded by delicate grey and white agate banding, showing natural formation layers.
Large blue specimen functions well as a decorative bookend or shelf accent
Geode features intricate internal crystal structures and smooth outer host rock
Total combined weight of 3.0 pounds as measured on digital scale
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished surfaces of the blue specimen are smooth with minor surface abrasions consistent with age. The natural geode remains intact with well-defined crystal formations and stable banding. No major chips or cracks beyond natural geological inclusions.

Natural Coral Marine Fossil Specimen on Round Wooden Display Base
This listing features a natural coral or marine fossil specimen mounted on a round unfinished wooden base. The specimen displays intricate wavy and porous formations with grayish-blue, white, and brown coloration. The surface texture is rough and pitted, typical of fossilized marine life. The wooden base shows handwritten markings, including the phrase 'Save for Sabina.' The item is in good condition with no major visible damage. Suitable for natural history collections or as a decorative display piece.
